headlines.description: — Bryce Harper and Bryan De La Cruz both homered, and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Baltimore Orioles 8-0 on Sunday in a game halted by rain after 5 1/2 innings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies rout Orioles 8-0 in a game called by rain after 5 1/2 innings

headlines.description: — Mike Yastrzemski homered and drove in two runs and the Atlanta Braves beat the slumping Washington Nationals 4-2 on Sunday to complete a rare four-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yastrzemski and Olson hit home runs as Braves top slumping Nationals 4-2 to complete 4-game sweep

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — José Fermin hit a tiebreaking single in the ninth inning and the St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1 on Sunday, avoiding a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fermin's tiebreaking hit in 4-run 9th helps Cardinals beat Blue Jays 5-1, avoid series sweep

headlines.description: — Gavin Williams allowed one hit in 5 2/3 innings and struck out 10, Chase DeLauter drove in three runs and the Cleveland Guardians defeated the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0 Sunday to avoid being swept in a weekend series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gavin Williams allows 1 hit, strikes out 10 to lead Guardians to 5-0 win over Diamondbacks

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Anthony Kay tossed 6 1/3 scoreless innings, Andrew Benintendi, Everson Pereira and Miguel Vargas hit home runs, and the Chicago White Sox beat the AL-leading Tampa Bay Rays 9-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kay pitches 6 scoreless, Benintendi, Vargas and Pereira homer as White Sox beat Rays 9-1

events.name: Miami Marlins at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Michael Petersen worked out of a bases-loaded jam with no outs in the seventh inning as the Miami Marlins beat the Mets 2-0 Sunday shortly after New York
headlines.shortLinkText: Petersen, Mack, Edwards lead the Marlins to a 2-0 win over the Mets

headlines.description: — Chase Burns won his 12th straight decision and Sal Stewart hit his 24th home run as the Cincinnati Reds beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 10-2 on Sunday to take three of four in the series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burns wins 12th straight decision, Stewart hits 24th HR, as Reds beat Pirates 10-2

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez tied a career high with four hits, Jeremy Peña hit a home run, and the Houston Astros used a four-run seventh inning to pull away from the Texas Rangers 7-3 on Sunday and complete a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez ties career high in hits, Peña homers and Astros use 4-run 7th inning to sweep Rangers 7-3

events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — José Caballero lined a two-run homer, Gerrit Cole pitched into the sixth inning and the New York Yankees hung on to top the Chicago Cubs 2-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caballero homers, Cole pitches into 6th and gets bullpen help as Yankees edge Cubs 2-1

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Kyle Freeland gave up one run and struck out eight in his first career complete game, Jake McCarthy hit a three-run homer, and the Colorado Rockies beat the Kansas City Royals 8-1 on Sunday to finish off a three-game series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeland dazzles in 99-degree heat with a complete game as the Rockies sweep the Royals

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Walbert Ureña pitched three-hit ball over six innings and Wade Meckler hit a two-run homer off Milwaukee ace Jacob Misiorowski as the Los Angeles Angels beat the Brewers 3-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ureña throws 3-hit ball for 6 innings, Meckler hits 2-run homer as Angels beat Brewers 3-0

headlines.description: — Keider Montero pitched six scoreless innings, Eduardo Valencia drove in four runs and the Detroit Tigers completed their first season-series sweep ever against an American League opponent with an 11-0 victory over the Athletics on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Tigers beat the A's 11-0 to complete their first season-series sweep vs. an AL team

headlines.description: — Colt Emerson singled to right in the ninth inning to score pinch-runner Stuard Fairchild from third for the Seattle Mariners' second straight walk-off victory over the Minnesota Twins, 7-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Emerson singles in 9th for Mariners' second straight walk-off victory over the Twins

events.name: San Francisco Giants at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill homered and Jake Cronenworth and Luis Campusano each had RBI for the San Diego Padres in a 5-4 win over the San Francisco Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Merrill's 2-run homer helps Padres beat Giants 5-4

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Ceddanne Rafaela homered for the third straight game and the Boston Red Sox beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 8-4 on Sunday night to sweep the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafaela homers for 3rd straight game as the Red Sox beat the Dodgers 8-4 for 3-game sweep
